name: WfMerge
author: waveformer
description: Bus merger, the routing-family chain tail: recombines the Main and AUX buses and always clears AUX. Mode DUAL or SWAP assigns the two paths to the output jacks (SWAP crossed, required after a WfSwap); MIX sums them on the Main and AUX levels. FtSw A/B turns the footswitch into a seamless A/B selector between the two paths. The ON/OFF toggle sets the footswitch mode: LATCH (press to toggle and stay) or UNLATCH (momentary, active only while held); UNLATCH with FtSw A/B gives momentary group switching (hold for group A, release for group B). Original effect by Waveformer.

params.name: Mode
params.explanation: DUAL: Main to the L jack, AUX to the R. SWAP: the same, crossed (required after a WfSwap). MIX: both summed into one stereo image.

params.name: Main
params.explanation: Level of the Main bus. 100 is unity.

params.name: AUX
params.explanation: Level of the AUX bus. 100 is unity.

params.name: FtSw
params.explanation: BYP: the footswitch bypasses normally. A/B: it selects which path you hear, as a seamless crossfade.

params.name: ON/OFF
params.explanation: Footswitch behaviour. LATCH: press toggles and stays. UNLATCH: active only while held (momentary); pair it with FtSw A/B for momentary group switching (hold for group A, release for group B). Firmware-owned; the audio kernel ignores this value.
